content.short: Booztory is an on-chain billboard where creators pay 1 USDC to feature their content for an hour.
content.description: Booztory is an on-chain spotlight for the internet: creators pay 1 USDC to feature their content for one hour, with no algorithm or gatekeepers deciding what is shown. It runs on Base and World Chain and is listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Booztory is an on-chain content spotlight on Base and World Chain, where 1 USDC buys an hour.
